Reorganization of the Quests page

The Quests page is currently undergoing reorganization. Major work is being done by User:Catwalksbyhimself and User:Black Tom. Assistance is welcome. The quests have been subcategorized by dungeons, and now each dungeon needs organizing, checking, and subcategorizing. Anyone who has new quests to add, or information about quests in the database, should go to Entering a Quest for help adding them.--Catwalksbyhimself 18:10, 20 October 2008 (CEST)
